memo:
## SENS — Senseonics Holdings | BUY · great trade · Bullish

*Signal $6.67 · Floor $5.00 · Re-rate $13 · Overshoot $32 · Catalyst window 9-18 months · Archetype N*

---

### Lineage: Macro → Theme → Mapping

**Macro regime it rides.** Structural diabetes/CGM adoption is a secular volume tailwind that runs largely independent of the rate/liquidity cycle — device penetration of the insulin-using cohort compounds regardless of the macro tape, and reimbursement (Medicare I-CGM LCD L38617 + commercial coverage) is a policy ratchet, not a cyclical lever. The macro line carried from Tier 0 is neutral, flagging the offsetting structural negatives: a tiny share against the Abbott/Dexcom ~98% incumbent lock and a balance-sheet-fragile, dilutive challenger. The bear that does NOT bite here is "cyclical-head-fake": SENS's move is product-cycle and commercial-control-reversion driven, not macro-beta. That makes it a name whose thesis can play out through a choppy regime — but a name whose own capital structure, not the cycle, is the dominant risk.

**Theme: why it qualifies, stage, recognition.** Continuous glucose monitoring is a real, large, already-monetized ~$15B / ~15%-CAGR market — not a TAM-fantasy and not a fake theme (both refuted: FDA-cleared product, live EU launches, accelerating revenue). The theme map grades this Next-Gen / Long-Duration CGM sub-theme HUNT (P3), surfaced via a bottom-up cluster plus a leading-indicator sweep, stage mid, recognition still OPEN — SENS sits near all-time lows despite +87% YoY revenue and a RAISED guide, i.e. the market is pricing dilution, not success. The demand mechanism is a shipping one-year implantable CGM converting to accelerating revenue against disposable incumbents, with payer breadth as the next unlock. The category precedent is decisive for sizing the prize and was re-anchored to CURRENT multiples this session: the CGM leaders historically re-rated to mid-single-digit-to-~21x trailing P/S at the height of their growth runs (DXCM ~21x at its 2015 peak), but the LIVE category now trades materially cheaper — DXCM ~5-6x trailing P/S today, TNDM matured to ~1.3x. The magnitude this archetype CAN travel is established; the magnitude the category PAYS for it today is mid-single-digit. That gap is the whole reason the ≥4x sits in the tail.

**Mapping: value-capture grade, vehicle vs benchmark.** SENS is the purest on-list DIRECT vehicle for this theme — the world-first 1-year implantable CGM pure-play, graded a STRONG proxy (TRIB an adequate R&D-stage on-list name; TNDM/DXCM weak off-list benchmarks only). But it is the CHALLENGER expression, not the theme leader: it captures a ~1% sliver of the TAM against a frictionless-disposable duopoly, and the implantable's in-office insertion procedure is a genuine adoption-friction ceiling (the "inferior-expression" bear — an unresolved binary that caps, but does not negate, the bull). Versus the DXCM/TNDM benchmark, two things still separate SENS from the winners and one newly aligns it: still-separating = the absent §7-3 firm-cash demand-pull anchor + the insertion ceiling; newly-aligned = the in-housed Ascensia commercial control (removing the exact 2019 channel-dependency failure vector) plus a SHOWN GAAP gross-margin inflection. The vehicle is the optionality on the only differentiated 365-day implantable — graded honestly as a great-trade expression, not a clean theme-leader compounder.

---

### Name-level thesis

**Thesis in a sentence.** A heavily-doubted, twice-failed-at-this-stage implantable-CGM challenger has, for the first time, taken commercial control in-house and printed a real 59% GAAP gross-margin inflection on two consecutive quarters of accelerating revenue — and this session added a first large one-year real-world-evidence package (ADA 2026: 93.19% one-year transmitter wear time, stable across both six-month halves) that de-risks the retention value-prop — so buy the optionality that the still-unshown AID/share-capture leg lands and re-rates the multiple into the (now cheaper) CGM-category band, with a financing-anchored floor 24% below and a dilution-discounted DXCM-style overshoot as the free right tail.

**What it does.** Senseonics makes Eversense — the only 365-day fully-implantable continuous glucose monitor (FDA-cleared Sep-2024, CE Mark Jan-2026). The differentiator is implant duration (a year vs the ~10-14 day disposables); the structural handicap is that insertion is an in-office procedure, not a self-applied patch.

**Why now.** Three things converged into a clean re-validation off the Q1-2026 10-Q (filed 2026-05-07), and this session added a fourth: (1) commercial control reverted in-house — the Ascensia revenue-share was eliminated Jan-1-2026, re-basing GAAP gross margin to ~59% (+~35pts YoY) and removing the literal 2019 channel-dependency failure vector; (2) the product cycle is demonstrably live — revenue +87% YoY (2nd consecutive accel after +71-72% in Q4-25), guidance RAISED to $60-64M (+70-82%), EU launch now executing (first insertions Sweden Apr / Spain May 2026), US DTC new-patient adds ~+100% YoY (DTC now ~60% of new-patient mix); (3) survival was de-risked and UPGRADED — the May-2026 ~$92M equity raise + $20M Hercules draw alleviated the going-concern doubt the 10-Q had raised, and management now explicitly states "sufficient cash to fund operations into 2028" on COMMITTED capital (excluding the ~$85M undrawn Hercules); (4) NEW this session — the ADA-2026 real-world dataset (12,360 Eversense 365 sensors at 93.19% avg wear time, COMPARABLE outcomes across both six-month halves, GMI 7.16%, TIR 66.16%; plus 153 closed-loop twiist-AID users at 99.46% median wear time, TIR 76.08%) is the firmest demand-conversion / adherence proxy SENS has produced and the clearest validation yet of the one-year-durability differentiation that is the entire thesis.

**The numbers.** Q1-26 revenue $11.71M, gross profit $6.94M = 59.3% GM (vs ~24% Q1-25; ~58% ex a $0.5M launch-timing benefit, ~54% on the CFO's stricter cut — immaterial). FY26 guide $60-64M revenue (+70-82%), 55-58% GM (Q1 already cleared it), $110-120M cash utilization, $150-160M OpEx, back-half-weighted ~40% H1 / 60% H2. Net loss $(32.3)M / $(0.71) on ~45.5M wtd-avg shares, almost entirely cash (SBC ~$2.3M). Survival math: ~$150-165M pro-forma liquidity (~$64.6M at 3/31 + ~$86M NET equity + ~$20M Hercules near-term tranches) against $110-120M FY26 burn = ~12-15 months at current burn, with management stating committed-capital runway INTO 2028 before drawing the ~$85M undrawn. Debt matures Sept-3-2029 — no near-term wall; covenant-compliant at 3/31. Accounting CLEAN GAAP (genuine gross profit tied to a structural channel-economics change, no capitalization games or channel-stuffing); accumulated deficit $1,049.3M and a distressed Altman-Z/Piotroski screen — both EXPECTED and uninformative for a pre-profit medtech, not manipulation flags.

**Valuation + geometry (floor and target, decoupled).** On ~$330-360M EV / ~$60-64M FY26 revenue, SENS trades ~5-6x forward EV/Rev today — squarely in the LIVE CGM-peer band, not a fantasy multiple. The football field spans ~$5 (floor) to ~$32-35 (overshoot high) across three archetype-N-appropriate methods, all computed on ~75M fully-diluted-through-2028 shares:
- **FLOOR $5.00** (~24% below the signal, ~0.75x spot): the May-2026 ~$92M raise clearing price — institutional fresh-cash commitment, pre-funded warrants @ $4.999, going-concern alleviated post-raise — with strategic-tuck-in (365-day implantable + sensor IP) and the $4.79 52-wk low beneath. Not a DCF; an archetype-N financing anchor, decoupled by construction from the target.
- **RE-RATE $13** (~2x): ~6-8x P/S on ~$120-150M revenue as AID/EU lands → ~$0.9-1.0B cap / ~75M FD. Revised DOWN from the prior $15 to honor the live peer de-rate fetched this session (DXCM only ~5-6x now). Sits just below the Street avg ~$15.75-16.67 — the Street figure is the optimistic edge of re-rate (fuller growth premium on a thinner share count), not its center.
- **OVERSHOOT $32** (~4.8x): the DXCM-2014/15 category-scaling anchor (~21x trailing P/S peak), applied HEAVILY discounted (low-double-digit P/S, not 21x — the discount even more justified now that the live category trades mid-single-digit and SENS carries serial dilution + an insertion ceiling DXCM never had) on ~$250-300M revenue → ~$2.0-3.5B cap / ~75M FD ≈ ~$27-47/share, midpoint $32. Street high $31 sits at the FLOOR of this tier. This is where the dilution-adjusted ≥4x lives — the reflexive right tail.

The floor is a financing-clearing anchor; the target is a revenue-ramp-times-multiple geometry. They are decoupled by construction.

**The dilution-adjusted per-share path — the crux that decided the type.** This was the #1 open question carried from Tier 2, and it is what separates multibagger from great-trade. Modeled fully-diluted-through-2028 ≈ ~75M shares (current ~52.2M basic + 8.0M pre-funded ≈ ~60.2M economic, plus one more modeled ~$80-100M raise in 2027 at ~$7-10 ≈ ~10-14M new, plus option/RSU + Hercules-warrant dilution). Per-share at each tier on ~75M FD: the overshoot ($2.5-3.5B cap) yields ~$33-47/share — the ≥4x IS mathematically reachable per-share even AFTER modeled dilution (dilution shaves ~20-25% off the no-dilution per-share but does not break the ≥4x in this tier); the re-rate yields ~$13-17/share (the ~2x survives dilution roughly intact); the base is ~2-2.5x. The verdict: the ≥4x is reachable per-share dilution-adjusted, but ONLY in the right-tail overshoot (P=0.12) that ALSO requires the still-absent §7-3 AID anchor + a §7-4 OCF inflection that does not yet exist. Relentless issuance at depressed prices confines the ≥4x to the tail; it does NOT zero the per-share thesis. THAT is precisely why SENS is a great trade (protected ~3-4x re-rate+overshoot blend) and NOT a base-case multibagger — and it confirms the prior 06-06 call over the Tier-2 provisional multibagger tag, which had not yet modeled the fully-diluted per-share count.

**The bear and why we're paid.** The decisive bear is the dilution-machine (real-and-mispriced): a pre-net-income model that REQUIRES periodic equity; ~$110-120M/yr burn vs ~$60M revenue; a $5.00 strike sitting ~25% below spot as a live overhang; an authorized common count DOUBLED 70M→140M; and a live $300M shelf / $100M ATM (S-3 333-289306, eff Aug-18-2025) making opportunistic at-any-price issuance structurally available. We are paid because this is a PATH-MAGNITUDE re-cut, NOT a §9 disqualifier and NOT ruin: it was a clean public offering + firm-cash Hercules draw (not a warrant-rebate/asset-sale "win"), only one raise this fiscal year, going-concern alleviated, committed-capital runway into 2028, debt matures 2029. The second bear — inferior-expression / insertion-friction ceiling — is an unresolved binary that caps the prize but does not negate the move; the ADA 93% one-year wear-time data SOFTENS the retention objection without removing the insertion ceiling. The third — twiist/AID asserted-not-shown (ADA n=153 is clinical, not commercial; no units/run-rate/backlog) — is the unresolved binary that decides re-rate vs dead-money. The market prices the SHOWN legs (59% GM, +87% accel, EU live, ADA durability) plus a dilution discount; it explicitly does NOT price the AID/share-capture ramp or any OCF inflection — that asymmetry is the pay.

**The call.** BUY · great trade · Bullish · expected path to the $13 re-rate over 12-18 months (driver: AID converting to disclosed units/run-rate + EU/DTC ramp holding the 59% GM, re-rating toward the mid-single-digit CGM-peer band plus a hyper-growth premium), with a right-tail overshoot to $32. Type is great trade not multibagger because the protected, high-probability shape is the ~3-4x re-rate+overshoot blend and the dilution-adjusted ≥4x is right-tail (P=0.12) not base. Conviction is Bullish not Extremely Bullish because the load-bearing growth leg (twiist/Sequel AID) is asserted-not-shown and the §7-4 cash-flow inflection is absent/adverse (OCF burn doubled to $32M/qtr — the GM inflection, now reinforced by ADA durability, is the only inflection shown). Prob-weighted ~$11.23 (≈ +68% over 12-18mo); blended U/D ~3.7:1, ~16:1 on the overshoot tail alone. The discriminator scorecard reads 0-of-4 cleanly PRESENT (§7-1 backlog ABSENT, §7-2 milestone PARTIAL, §7-3 firm-cash ABSENT, §7-4 margin-PRESENT-but-OCF-ABSENT so net PARTIAL) — and the absences land EXACTLY where the thesis needs them, the round-tripper tell that is the structural reason the ≥4x lives in the tail.

**How we'd be wrong.** Three pre-mortems, none of them ruin: (1) dilution round-trip — the live shelf/ATM plus a 2027 follow-on print at/below a stalled price, the $5.00 strike capping every rally, per-share economics re-cut faster than revenue compounds, and the position grinds sideways-to-down even as the business "works" (a path-magnitude loss bounded near the $5 floor, ~25-30% permanent-impairment probability — NOT a zero; survival clears >6 qtrs, debt 2029, going-concern alleviated); (2) the AID leg never lands — twiist/Sequel AID stays qualitative "encouraging" with no disclosed units for another 18mo (ADA n=153 is clinical, not commercial), revenue plateaus on the ~$80-100M EU/DTC organic ramp, the multiple compresses toward the live DXCM ~5-6x, and the re-rate simply doesn't fire (dead-money near floor); (3) the insertion-friction ceiling bites — the in-office implantable keeps SENS a ~1% sliver against the ~98% frictionless-disposable duopoly, the market re-confirms the inferior-expression bear and refuses the category multiple, and even a SHOWN OCF inflection earns only a small-cap-medtech ~3-4x. The discipline: §7-1 backlog ABSENT, §7-3 firm-cash anchor ABSENT, §7-4 OCF leg ABSENT/adverse — three of four discriminator legs lean on the unshown future, so this is a great-trade right-tail bet on a re-rate, not a high-confidence base-case multibagger.
